conclusion: Common small-closed-contour preservation and independent organic bed-support placement remain unchanged. Their earlier 18 contour and 80 planner combinations retain their recorded implementation scope. Current thin-bed coverage now includes 12 combinations across both print sequences. Fresh X2 and Vulcan600 current-preset slices retain their endpoints and canonical deposition geometry while using one filtered emitted-layer plan for header/footer/progress counts. Vulcan600 has 1553 actual emitted layers, first support nominal Z0.2375, exact next support Z0.2875 and unchanged configured gap0.2125; X2 has 2251 nonempty emitted records and 3 deposition moves at final Z246.4. Earlier X600HD native results remain historical. No device-specific setting, physical print, install or publication selects or qualifies these fixes.
